proposed_comments.body:
### Normalize calculator spacing

**Severity:** `low`

Non-blocking formatting suggestion: remove the extra parameter spacing and align the return statement with the existing method body. Keep the default and expression unchanged; this does not change the lock-screen policy.

```suggestion
    internal static ExecutionState ComputeAwakeState(bool keepDisplayOn, bool isScreenLocked, bool allowDisplayOffWhileLocked = true)
    {
        return keepDisplayOn && !(isScreenLocked && allowDisplayOffWhileLocked)
```

proposed_comments.title: Retain exception context when the tray toggle fails
proposed_comments.body:
### Retain exception context when the tray toggle fails

**Severity:** `low`

Non-blocking diagnostic improvement: the new catch logs only the exception message. Use the existing `Logger.LogError(string, Exception)` overload so a settings read/save failure also retains its type, inner exception and stack trace. Keep the current catch and settings-reload behavior; no normal toggle failure is asserted.

```suggestion
                Logger.LogError("Failed to toggle lock display policy.", ex);
```
